deterministicReplacements.old:
ilw.w   stateFlag, 0(buffer)
    iaddiu  vertexCounter, vi00, VU1_STAPIP_CORONA_SPRITE_FLAG
    iand    stateFlag, stateFlag, vertexCounter
    ibeq    stateFlag, vi00, coronaReturn
    ilw.w   vertexCount, 0(buffer)
deterministicReplacements.new:
ilw.w   vertexCount, 0(buffer)
    iaddiu  vertexCounter, vi00, VU1_STAPIP_CORONA_SPRITE_FLAG
    iand    stateFlag, vertexCount, vertexCounter
    ibeq    stateFlag, vi00, coronaReturn

deterministicReplacements.old:
; Q domain excludes exceptional/underflow comparisons.
    loi     0.0001
deterministicReplacements.new:
; Q domain excludes exceptional/underflow comparisons.
    ; One existing dead VI holds the shared sign mask for both bounds.
    iaddiu  fogInt, vi00, 0x20
    loi     0.0001

deterministicReplacements.old:
iaddiu  singleColorEnabled, vi00, 0x20
    fmand   singleColorEnabled, singleColorEnabled

iaddiu  vertexCounter, vi00, 0x4000
    iadd    vertexCounter, vertexCounter, vertexCounter
    iand    singleColorEnabled, singleColorEnabled, vertexCounter
deterministicReplacements.new:
; adcMask is the stock persistent0x8000 initialized before begin.
    iand    singleColorEnabled, singleColorEnabled, adcMask

deterministicReplacements.old:
iaddiu  singleColorEnabled, vi00, 15
    fmand   singleColorEnabled, singleColorEnabled
    iaddiu  fogInt, vi00, 15
deterministicReplacements.new:
iaddiu  fogInt, vi00, 15
    fmand   singleColorEnabled, fogInt

    fmand   singleColorEnabled, singleColorEnabled
